players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh sat out for the third straight game Monday with a sore right side. MRI results are pending; manager Dan Wilson expects an IL decision as soon as Tuesday. Mitch Garver is filling in at catcher.

sources.title: Cal Raleigh Injury: Still sitting out Monday | RotoWire
Mariners catcher Cal Raleigh sitting out 3rd straight game | Washington Post

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper went 3-for-4 with his 7th HR (393-ft solo shot to right-center off a sweeper), a double, and a single in the Phillies' 1-0 win over the Marlins. Nola worked 6 strong innings under new interim manager Mattingly; Phillies have won 4 straight.

sources.title: Bryce Harper, Aaron Nola have big nights as Phillies take 3 of 4 from Marlins
Harper hits his 7th homer, Nola works 6 strong innings | Washington Post

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 2-for-4 with two doubles and scored twice as San Francisco snapped a 6-game losing streak 3-2 over the Padres. Rookie Trevor McDonald tossed 7 sharp innings in his season debut.

sources.title: Schmitt homers, McDonald sharp as Giants edge Padres 3-2 to end 6-game skid

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 0-for-4 with a strikeout in the Mets' 4-2 win at Colorado. New York's four-run sixth inning was the difference; Williams closed it out.

sources.title: 5/4/2026 Box Score: New York Mets 4 Colorado Rockies 2 | Mets News and Links

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle was named AL Rookie of the Month for March/April — hitting .328/.426/.509 with 15 extra-base hits and 22 runs in 31 games. He was given a scheduled rest day Monday vs Boston as the Tigers entered the day tied for first in the AL Central at 18-18.

sources.title: Kevin McGonigle is named AL Rookie of the Month | MLB.com
Hits keep coming for Tigers' Kevin McGonigle — and now an award, too

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA led off the 9th with a triple (misplayed off the ivy wall) and scored the tying run on Hoerner's sac fly. Michael Conforto then hit a walk-off solo HR to cap the 5-4 comeback win, extending the Cubs' home win streak to 11 games.

sources.title: Michael Conforto's pinch-hit walk-off shot lifts Cubs over Reds

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill missed Monday's game vs San Francisco after aggravating a left ankle injury sustained Friday. He is listed as day-to-day and expressed frustration but hopes to return during the series.

sources.title: Jackson Merrill in question as Padres prep for Giants - CBS Sports

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez singled in the Dodgers' 8-3 win over the Astros but is expected to be placed on the 10-day IL around May 6 with a left groin strain — a condition he battled through for much of the 2025 season as well.

sources.title: Dodgers' Teoscar Hernandez Will Be Placed on IL With Groin Injury | Bleacher Report
Dodgers Bats Finally Awaken in Comfortable Win over Houston

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams nailed down his 4th save with a perfect 9th inning as the Mets beat the Rockies 4-2. His season ERA remains elevated at 6.55 but he continues to pick up save opportunities.

sources.title: New York Mets vs. Colorado Rockies Results - May 4, 2026 | CBS Sports

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler did not pitch Monday (Nola started in the series finale). Through 2 starts since returning from thoracic outlet syndrome surgery, Wheeler has a 2.45 ERA with 14 K in 11 IP as the Phillies have won 4 straight under interim manager Don Mattingly.

sources.title: Wheeler sharp, Phillies survive late chaos to extend win streak | Philadelphia Baseball Review

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans did not start Monday as Michael Wacha opened the 4-game home series vs Cleveland. Ragans is lined up for Game 3. The Royals and Guardians are tied for first in the AL Central; Ragans expressed eagerness to help KC win the series.

sources.title: Cole Ragans eager to lead Royals to series win vs. Guardians

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns threw a career-high 7 scoreless innings vs the Pirates on Sunday (3 H, 1 BB, 7 K, 94 pitches) but got a no-decision as the Reds lost 1-0 on a walk-off in the 8th. He did not pitch Monday and is on regular rotation rest.

sources.title: Chase Burns throws seven scoreless innings, Reds lose to Pirates | MLB.com

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi did not pitch Monday and is lined up to start Tuesday vs the Yankees — his 8th start of 2026. His last outing was 7 strong IP with 0 ER and 7 K vs New York on April 29, his best start of a season he began with a rocky stretch.

sources.title: Nathan Eovaldi, Rangers keep Yankees off the board

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan did not pitch Monday as Yamamoto (6 IP, 3 ER, 8 K) started in Houston. The Dodgers won 8-3 as the offense broke out of a slump, with Tucker, Freeland, Ohtani, and Freeman all driving in runs.

sources.title: Dodgers Bats Finally Awaken in Comfortable Win over Houston

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers did not pitch Monday as Jose Soriano (5-1, 0.84 ERA) started for the Angels vs the White Sox. Detmers remains in the rotation for his next scheduled turn.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice was held out of Monday's lineup vs Baltimore after leaving Sunday's game with a left hand contusion sustained on a pickoff throw from Max Fried. X-rays were negative; he is day-to-day and could not swing with full force per manager Aaron Boone.

sources.title: Yankees' Ben Rice: Leaves early with hand contusion | CBS Sports
